gri_path: GRI 1: the holder assembly is not itself a good named in another chapter 84/85 heading
Section XVI note 2(b): parts suitable for use solely or principally with one kind of machine (paper-making machinery of heading 8439) are classified with that machine, i.e., in 8439.99 parts
GRI 6: 8439.99 parts, other (not of pulp-making machinery 8439.91); 8439.99.10 of machinery for making paper or paperboard

rejected_alternatives.reason: that line is for parts of machinery for finishing paper; the holders are used on papermaking machines
parts of machinery for making pulp; the holders serve the paper machine itself
965589 placed doctor blade steel in material lengths in chapter 72 because it was not a finished part; holder assemblies are finished and dedicated to the paper machine

classification.rationale: Doctor blade holder assemblies are finished components used solely or principally on papermaking machines, so Section XVI note 2(b) classifies them with that machinery as parts in heading 8439. HQ 965589 (in force) describes doctor blades as working against rolls in all sections of papermaking machines, and it treated unfinished blade steel as steel only because it was in material lengths, unlike these finished holder assemblies. The applicable line is 8439.99.10.00, parts of machinery for making paper or paperboard.
